abilities.name: Animus Malorum (Wargear — Daemon Skull-Relic)
abilities.text:
The skull-relic in Centurius's off-hand drinks the souls of the dying within its reach, and returns them as the manifested forms of his fallen brothers.

Each time an enemy model is destroyed within 12" of this model by any cause (friendly attack, ranged or melee), place one Soul counter beside this model. Centurius can hold a maximum of 3 Soul counters at any time. Once per turn, in your Command phase OR at the end of any phase in which a friendly Damned Legionnaires unit lost one or more models, you can spend 1 Soul counter to return one destroyed Damned Legionnaire model to a friendly Damned Legionnaires unit on the battlefield within 9" of Centurius. The returned model is set up in Unit Coherency, more than 6" from any enemy unit, with 1 wound remaining. The soul is consumed in the act of manifestation.

abilities.name: Vengeful Spectre
abilities.text: If a friendly Damned Legionnaires unit was destroyed earlier in this battle, each time this model or its attached unit makes an attack against the enemy unit that destroyed the Damned Legionnaires, re-roll all failed Hit rolls AND failed Wound rolls. Centurius hunts the killers of his fallen brothers across the war.

abilities.name: Manifestation
abilities.text: During deployment, instead of setting up this model and its attached unit on the battlefield, you can place it in Strategic Reserves. From battle round 1, this model and its unit can arrive: set up wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge OR wholly within 6" of a Damned Legionnaires unit on the battlefield, and more than 6" from any enemy models. The Damned arrive where they are needed, not where they are expected.
